exclusiveMachineAttestation: Exclusive MoonTxnWitness local measurement window. No other project compilation, database, packaging or download work is scheduled locally; ordinary OS and desktop background activity is uncontrolled.

protocol.coldProcess: Separate fresh process, one call, no warmup
protocol.controlThreshold: candidate minus baseline <= max(10% baseline, 2ms) for warm median/P95 and cold process median
